title: Masks of the Old Potentate
summary: In the aqueduct-fed basin of Rimmen, master mask-artisans, quarry labourers, and Baandari pedlars uncover an old Akaviri potentate cipher being used to extort the stone-cutters.

hook.rumour: Quarry workers under Rimmen's great aqueduct found a cache of lacquered Potentate masks in the limestone cut, and the city bailiffs immediately seized the whole gallery.
hook.notice: RIMMEN ARTISANS' QUARTER & BAANDARI POST: Discreet investigators sought to recover the stolen quarry tallies and decipher the Potentate mask-seals.

npcs.name: Warden of Rimmen
npcs.greet: Quarry workers under Rimmen's great aqueduct found a cache of lacquered Potentate masks in the limestone cut, and the city bailiffs immediately seized the whole gallery.
talk: The trouble across Rimmen began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Rimmen.
If you mean to help the Aqueduct Court of Rimmen, start by checking the trail between Rimmen and Tonenaka Shrine.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Rimmen
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Tonenaka Shrine is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Tonenaka Shrine toward Rimmen Palace before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Rimmen so Potentate-Steward Zurin-Dar can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Rimmen Palace
npcs.greet: You made good time from Tonenaka Shrine. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Hall of the Lunar Champion.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Hall of the Lunar Champion with a picked guard.
Once Hall of the Lunar Champion is cleared, return to Rimmen to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Rimmen
npcs.greet: Potentate-Steward Zurin-Dar awaits word on whether the crisis in Rimmen has been contained.
talk: The elders of Rimmen have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Rimmen owes you a debt for standing between Rimmen and ruin.
